title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Tier Schedule — Entry Requirements, Credit Line Range and Personal Guarantee
content:
Each Ridgeline Pro Credit tier sets the business profile an application must meet, the range within which Commercial Credit assigns the credit line, and whether a principal's personal guarantee is required to open the account. The revolving tiers are the Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge and Pro Revolving Charge Plus; the pay-in-full tiers are the four Ridgeline Commercial Account tiers.

## Entry requirements

A business meets a tier's entry requirements when its years in business, its business credit score and its annual revenue are each at or above the figure shown for that tier.

| Tier | Minimum years in business | Minimum business credit score | Minimum annual revenue (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge | 1 | 60 | 50000.00 |
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge Plus | 2 | 70 | 250000.00 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 30 | 2 | 65 | 150000.00 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 30 Select | 3 | 75 | 750000.00 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 45 | 5 | 80 | 3000000.00 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 60 Enterprise | 7 | 80 | 10000000.00 |

## Credit line range and guarantee

The lowest credit line is the smallest line assigned at the tier. The highest credit line is the largest line the tier can carry, including after a credit line increase.

| Tier | Lowest credit line (USD) | Highest credit line (USD) | Personal guarantee of a principal required to open |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge | 1000.00 | 9500.00 | Yes |
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge Plus | 10000.00 | 24500.00 | Yes |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 30 | 2500.00 | 24500.00 | Yes |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 30 Select | 25000.00 | 99500.00 | No |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 45 | 100000.00 | 249500.00 | No |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 60 Enterprise | 250000.00 | 1000000.00 | No |

## Reading the schedule

- Each requirement is met at the figure itself: a business with exactly 2 years in business meets the 2-year requirement of the Pro Revolving Charge Plus.
- The tiers are not nested. The Commercial Account Net 30 asks for a lower credit score (65) than the Pro Revolving Charge Plus (70) but a different revenue figure (150000.00 against 250000.00).
- Hypothetical example: a business with 4 years in business, a score of 78 and annual revenue of 900000.00 meets every figure of the Commercial Account Net 30 Select (3, 75, 750000.00) and falls short of the Commercial Account Net 45 on every figure (5, 80, 3000000.00).
